# HR Performance and Benefits Review Tasks

This document details a series of review tasks for the HR department:

*   Review career development urgently.
*   Update annual leave quarterly.
*   Investigate medical insurance standard updates.
*   Review medical insurance quarterly.
*   Review career development quarterly.
